exam.title: Mathematics II - Exam B
exam.subtitle: Power series, vector calculus, integrals, ODE
exam.instructions: Complete all tasks and show your work. Permitted aids: non-programmable calculator.

exercises.title: Radius of Convergence
exercises.description:
Determine the radius and interval of convergence of
$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{n^2}{3^n}x^n$.
solutionSteps:
Step 3: Endpoints
At $x=3$: terms $n^2$ → diverges
At $x=-3$: terms $(-1)^n n^2$ → diverges
Interval: $(-3,3)$

exercises.title: Convergence and Value
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Convergence
$\frac{1}{x^2+1} \le \frac{1}{x^2}$ for $x\ge1$, so the integral converges.

exercises.title: Potential Field
exercises.description:
Given $\vec{F}(x,y)=(2xy, x^2+2y)$.

a) Show that $\vec{F}$ is conservative.
b) Find a potential function.
c) Compute the line integral from $(0,0)$ to $(1,1)$.
solutionSteps:
Step 1: Curl-free check
$P=2xy$, $Q=x^2+2y$
$\partial P/\partial y = 2x$, $\partial Q/\partial x = 2x$ $\Rightarrow$ conservative.

Step 2: Potential
Integrate $P$ w.r.t. $x$: $\phi(x,y)=x^2y+g(y)$
Then $\phi_y = x^2+g'(y) = Q = x^2+2y \Rightarrow g'(y)=2y$, $g(y)=y^2$
Potential: $\phi(x,y)=x^2y+y^2$

exercises.title: Integral over the Unit Disk
solutionSteps:
Step 2: Integral
$\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^1 r^2\cdot r\,dr\,d\theta = \int_0^{2\pi}\left[\frac{r^4}{4}\right]_0^1 d\theta = \int_0^{2\pi} \frac{1}{4} d\theta$

exercises.title: First-Order Linear ODE
exercises.description:
Solve the initial value problem
$y' + 2y = x$, $y(0)=0$.
solutionSteps:
Step 3: Solution form
$e^{2x}y = \frac{1}{2}xe^{2x} - \frac{1}{4}e^{2x} + C \Rightarrow y = \frac{1}{2}x - \frac{1}{4} + Ce^{-2x}$
